name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-intranet-page-lifecycle-review
title: SharePoint Page Governance
shortDescription: Audits a SharePoint Site Pages library and creates a read-only lifecycle report for stale, draft, unpublished, and checked-out pages.
longDescription: Reviews the current SharePoint site's Site Pages library and identifies pages that are stale, still in draft, never published, changed after publication, or checked out.
Creates a self-contained HTML report with lifecycle classifications, page links, ownership details, recommended follow-up actions, and explicit limitations without changing pages or library items.
